run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 core government portals swept broadly via WebSearch (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders). Tier 2 covered via a rotating sample: Sydney Water and Melbourne Water (GBE water), Queensland Health and NSW Health (public health), RMIT and University of Sydney (universities), and local councils via VendorPanel (Inner West, Hawkesbury, Tamworth). Tier 3 corporate mandatory sweep run: SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP and Rio Tinto (mining, publicly-advertised EOIs captured), plus energy/mining peer discovery (Chevron, INPEX, South32, Glencore, Newmont, Shell, Bunnings) recorded as portals. Source discovery yielded 7 new buyer-originated portals. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: WebFetch and direct HTTP (curl) were egress-blocked (HTTP 403 from the network egress proxy) for ALL external domains this run, so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened. Every tender below is headline-level, extracted from WebSearch result titles/URLs/snippets only; deliverables/requirements/values/contacts/exact closing times are largely unread and all entries are counted in entries_pending_detail.
gaps: WebFetch and Bash curl were both egress-blocked (HTTP 403 CONNECT tunnel failed from the agent egress proxy) for every external host this run, including tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au and vendorpanel.com.au. Only the WebSearch tool was usable, so no detail/specification page could be opened.

Consequently deliverables_summary, key_deliverables, requirements, eligibility, evaluation_criteria, values, documents, contacts and exact closing times could not be read from detail pages; where present they are paraphrased from search-result snippets of the notice and still need a detail-page/authenticated verification pass.

Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing hubs (SAP Ariba Discovery, Coupa, Jaggaer) require login to view individual open RFx; no publicly-visible corporate RFx detail could be read, so BHP's 'Design, Supply and Commission of Mechanical Equipment' EOI and similar were noted at portal level rather than captured as verified tenders.
Invitation-only corporate RFPs (e.g. management-consultancy panels) remain out of scope and were not fabricated.
Melbourne Water Cardinia Dam Upgrade appeared in search but its RFP closed 27 March 2026 and was therefore excluded as no longer open.
